svg.title: TP03 cross-sector tacit-knowledge evidence organized by coverage
svg.desc: Global TP03 connects directly to three sector practice instances. Each sector is divided into tacit knowledge shared across three sectors, shared across two sectors, and specific to one sector, with representative case-level TP and TK evidence.
svg.text: Tacit-knowledge evidence reorganized by three-sector, two-sector, and sector-specific coverage
